Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.
Card Q&A.q: I activated this card's [On Play] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the rest of this effect?

Effect: [On Play] If there are 5 or more cards with [Myotismon] in their names in your trash, delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon and trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
[When Digivolving] Trash the top 5 cards of your deck. Then, if there's a card with [Myotismon] in its name in your trash, gain 1 memory.
